written_by: Claude Code, drafted from the Cal-GETC Standards version 1.4 for Ryan Saleh to check
notes: The Cal-GETC areas for the Plan (spec 24 → Data, ge_areas), from section 2, Areas of Distribution for Cal-GETC, and its summary table (pages 3 and 4) of the Cal-GETC Standards, Policies and Procedures version 1.4 (2026), approved May 15, 2026, which ICAS lists as the current version (https://icas-ca.org/whats-new/). Names are the standards' area names in title case, as the summary table prints them. courses and units are the semester figures. Area 4 is two courses from two disciplines, 6 units. 5C, Laboratory, is 1 unit in the standards but is met by the lab in a 5A or 5B course (section 9.5.2), so it has courses 0 and units 0 here and gets no card; the standards also ask for at least 7 units across area 5 (section 9.5), which 3 + 3 + 0 doesn't show. academic_year is 2026-27, the year this version applies to. A second person checks each row against the standards. Then run: npm run import -- data/raw/planning/cal-getc.json --dry-run
